name: comp-246
title: Slider With Ticks
description: A one-handle range slider on a dark surface. Its track fills to the left of the knob and a row of ticks with even numbers sits underneath as reference points.
use: Users should pick a small integer from a visible scale and want the steps spelled out.
avoid: Precise or free-form values are needed: the ticks suggest fixed steps only.
a11y: The slider carries an aria-label, but the tick scale and numbers are hidden from screen readers with aria-hidden. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bold white label sits above a long grey track with a bright filled portion on the left and a round white knob. Under the track runs a fine row of tick marks, and beneath that the even numbers 0 through 12 in small grey type.
behaves: Dragging the knob moves the filled portion with it and shows a soft ring around the knob while held. The value slides smoothly between the twelve steps marked by the ticks.
customise: The label text, maximum value and tick-skipping interval live in the source; the starting value is fixed. Slider colours follow the theme tokens.
weight: light: One track, one handle and a row of static spans; nothing animates while idle.
